Hi Alyssa / Samir,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the retrieval / RAG evaluation: 

1) Primary goals we captured
- Grounding accuracy on clinical KB (no hallucinations; regulatory sensitivity)
- Latency target for user-facing search: 95th percentile <= 300ms
- Cost / token efficiency for mixed chat + search flows

2) What we propose to evaluate (PoC scope)
- Model candidates: redwood-alpha-2-13B (quantized), llm-3-70b-q4 (high-recall), mistral-instruct-7B (lightweight baseline)
- Retrieval stack options: BM25 initial filtering -> dense dual-encoder (SBERT/Contriever) ANN (FAISS IVF-PQ) -> optional cross-encoder reranker
- Reranker choices to compare: cross-encoder-mpnet-base-v2 (high-quality), distilled-cross-encoder (latency-optimized)
- Metrics: precision@1/3, MRR, grounding_rate (fraction of answers citing a doc & matching gold), hallucination_rate (false assertions), 95p latency (query+rerank+generation)

3) Quick operational asks
- We'll run an initial synthetic eval using the prompt set attached (novusmed_prompt_set.csv) — 200 prompts from your sample. Please confirm this dataset is redacted of PHI.
- Please confirm a contact in Data Ops for read-only S3 access (or indicate if you prefer us to run in Private VPC).

4) Proposed timeline/next steps
- By EOD Thu (2026-09-23): approval to run synthetic eval on sample prompts + confirm data access path
- Week of 9/27: small-scale PoC (10k docs) to measure recall/grounding + latency baselines
- Mid-Oct: full-scale PoC and handoff to your engineering team

Links: preliminary eval dashboard -> https://app.redwood.ai/eval/novusmed-poc-2026 (I will populate with baseline runs). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Hi Alyssa / team — adding more detail on the eval plan and concrete retrieval/rerank recommendations so you can review before the Data Ops sync.

Evaluation plan (3 phases) - Phase 0 (synthetic): run 200 prompt set (attached) against current KB snapshots to get quick signal on grounding_rate and hallucination rate.
- Phase 1 (small PoC): 10k-doc subset (representative) to validate retrieval config and reranker tradeoffs at scale.
- Phase 2 (full PoC): run on full 600k dataset with load testing and latency SLOs.

Retrieval stack recommendations - Candidate 1 (latency-first): BM25 filter (Elasticsearch) -> dense bi-encoder (SBERT-contriever) with FAISS IVF-PQ (nlist=16384, nprobe=64) -> no cross-encoder rerank for UI path (use lightweight distil reranker offline for analytics). Expected 95p Q+R+gen latency: ~220-320ms depending on instance sizing.
- Candidate 2 (quality-first): BM25 -> dense dual-encoder + cross-encoder re-ranker (cross-encoder-mpnet-base-v2). Expected 95p latency: ~400-600ms (cross-encoder dominates). Use as fallback for high-confidence answers or long-form assistant flows.

Reranker options & tradeoffs - Cross-encoder (mpnet) — best grounding precision, higher cost and latency; recommended for high-stakes clinical answers or agent responses where a citation is required.
- Distilled cross-encoder — ~2-3x faster, slightly lower precision (~3-6 points), better for interactive UIs.
- Document-level heuristics (title/metadata boosting) can recover ~5% precision without cross-encoder cost.

Metrics and pass/fail thresholds (suggested) - precision@1 >= 0.85 on curated eval set
- grounding_rate (answers with at least one correct citation) >= 0.90
- hallucination_rate <= 0.05 (measured on adversarial prompts)
- MRR >= 0.80
- 95th percentile latency (UI path) <= 300ms (no cross-encoder) or <= 450ms (if cross-encoder used selectively)

Operational notes for Private VPC run (what we need)
- Read-only S3 bucket or R/O Elasticsearch snapshot URL
- Service account SSO user for Redwood infra with minimal IAM scope (read-only)
- Network egress rules (we support VPC peering or customer-run package)

Deliverables & timing - Synthetic eval results (with benchmark_results_v1.pdf summary) -> 2 business days after sign-off
- Small PoC baseline reports (latency, precision, grounding) -> 1 week
- Full-scale PoC -> 3 weeks (includes iteration on reranker thresholds)

Next steps I recommend - Alyssa: confirm dataset redaction + Data Ops contact by EOD Thu 9/23
- Karthik: schedule 30-min access + privacy sync (Neha to lead)
- If approved, we’ll spin up Phase 0 runs and share a populated eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/eval/novusmed-poc-2026

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the PDF and FAISS knobs if useful.
